Actual reconciliation tests cover game-specific retention, variant reset and unavailable chip removal. Successful and invalid catalog-pair tests plus delayed-response and timeout controls pass.

Independent node tools/test_dealership.mjs execution exited 0 on these exact hashes. The focused manifest records six passes, zero failed/skipped checks; I inspected its actual viewer-loading, native-catalog, MC3-preview, library-filter and server logs as well. E15 records expanded details with 120px list minimum, 1047px sidebar content within a 500px scrollable sidebar, and nonzero help width. CSS supplies overflow-y:auto and prevents non-list controls shrinking. E15 is geometry/overflow evidence, not a recorded full keyboard navigation trace.

The patch addresses demonstrated compound name/year search failures, stale unavailable source variants, cramped sidebar access and stale semantic pending state. Browser artifacts and corpus/handler tests demonstrate those bounded outcomes; extra filters are disclosed through native details, labeled groups and visible provider help.
